title: Perform a full system upgrade
summary: Upgrade installed packages, remove obsolete ones, and install new dependencies. This is more aggressive than a simple upgrade.

steps.explain: Upgrade installed packages, remove obsolete packages, and install additional packages to meet new dependencies.

alternatives.explain: Upgrades installed packages, removes obsolete packages, and installs additional packages to meet new dependencies.

rollback.explain: Downgrading packages is complex and not directly supported by apt-get. It is recommended to test upgrades in a safe environment.

warnings: This command may remove packages. Review the changes carefully.
